candidate_condition_changes.text: Forget it Torro. You can bang on that door all night if you want. There is no way in Oblivion I'm letting you in!
Ha! It meant plenty! Plenty of lost pay because nobody wants to flirt with a barmaid whose face is all purple and swollen up with bruises.
candidate_condition_changes.note: Already reviewed Korean text; important additional source-plugin risk not included in original 4 holds.

candidate_condition_changes.text: There's a difference between being mad at a lover who's generally not so bad, and finding out that you've been sweet-talked by a scamp-eating dreugh-face who slips out once in a while from his mistresses from all over Cyrodiil!
Do yourself a favor Torro and get some help. Yes! From Grindion or Hernantier!
Somebody? Torro, it's a regular Bretonic love-festival in here! I... I've got all the Imperial City arena fighters with me and... and...

control_examples.speaker: Torro
control_examples.text: I can't believe you're doing this to me, Melly. After everything we've been through.

control_examples.speaker: Torro
control_examples.text: I know you're angry, my darling. And I forgive you, even though you haven't even asked me to!

control_examples.speaker: Torro
control_examples.text: That hurt, Melly. It's okay if you pretend to be mad, but you don't have to kick me between the legs too!

control_examples.speaker: Torro
control_examples.text: I could swear I heard somebody in there with you just now.

validation_required: Before plugin-level fix, inspect full original CTDA OR/AND flags, INFO sequence, voice assets and whether speaker swap requires additional Faction/Quest/Voice-type adjustments.
Check that changing GetIsID to Melyssa is valid when scene occurs behind a closed door and whether her cell state permits dialogue.
Test in-game with current Better Cities 6.6.0 and IC 6.6.0a enabled.
Keep translated dialogue faithful to the intended speaker. Do not change current source plugin until validated.
note: Original engine-specific Oblivion TES4 data does not use later-game SCEN structure; validate through INFO, quests, scripts and gameplay.
